items.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Jimmy was the only one -- you know, I did the composing, he did the arranging.

ctx.x: Well that was what I was going to ask. So how do you start to develop your staff and how do you start to develop this business, just for any other entrepreneurs?

No, Jimmy was the only one -- you know, I did the composing, he did the arranging. And I went out and got the jobs, I went out and hustled the spots. I went out and, you know, hung out and did, you know -­
So you didn’t hire a publicist, you didn’t have a manager?
